file.description: Path to the Playwright spec file to verify.

heal.description: If verification fails, spawn a nested Claude with the captured error output and let it fix the spec in place. Off by default so CI stays a pure check.

maxRetries.description: Only used with --heal. Number of heal attempts after the initial verify fails. Each heal re-invokes Claude with fresh error context. 0 = one heal attempt total.

model.description: Only used with --heal. Model alias passed to the nested `claude -p` invocation (e.g. opus, sonnet, haiku).

timeoutMinutes.description: Only used with --heal. Kill the nested claude process if it runs longer than this many minutes.

skipPermissions.description: Only used with --heal. Pass --dangerously-skip-permissions to the nested claude so it doesn't prompt for tool approvals. Recommended for demos.
